messages:
Zoe Park: dropping a fresh direction — trying a split-control in the composer: primary icon is Interrupt (icon-only), a small chevron opens a tiny menu with 'Regenerate (restart)' and 'Regenerate (append)'. aim is to clarify whether regen replaces or continues. thoughts?
Ethan Wu: interesting. word choice is important. 'Restart' vs 'Replace' both sound destructive. maybe 'Restart generation' and 'Resume with new output' ?
Harper Lin: +1. also add a subtle confirmation row when user picks the menu option: tiny text 'This will restart the response' for restart, and 'This will append new content' for append. avoid modal confirmations.
Noah Bennett: infra note: append flow is trickier: we either stream additional tokens or spawn a separate generation appended to the message. need a clear schema. we can implement as separate event/appended response to keep KV cache consistent.
Leah Ortiz: accessibility: menu items must be role=menuitem and announce the chosen action. Use aria-live only on completion: 'Generation restarted' / 'Generation appended'. do NOT announce intermediate token counts.
Zoe Park: copy variant testing: microcopy options for menu entries: A) 'Regenerate (restart)' B) 'Regenerate — restart' C) 'Regenerate and replace'. prefer short and clear. I'll mock A/B in figma.
Ethan Wu: keyboard accessibility: allow Cmd+/Ctrl+. for regen, Shift+Cmd/Ctrl+. to open the regen menu. Also Space to toggle interrupt when composer focused. surface shortcuts in tooltip.
Harper Lin: token counter UX: try a compact 'heat-meter' — small bar that fills as tokens stream, with a numeric pill showing "~120" while streaming and exact number when done. respects reduced-motion by disabling fill animation.
Noah Bennett: telemetry: batch token changes; UI samples every 600ms, backend aggregates every 8s. add a flag for orgs to disable live token UI to reduce data exposure.
Leah Ortiz: privacy/accessibility note: when live token UI is disabled, screen readers should still get final announcement and the composer should show 'Token count hidden by org' in the prompt preview.
Zoe Park: prompt library tie: show 'Tok est: 34' beneath prompt titles, but use 'Tok est' abbreviation to keep label short. hover shows tooltip 'Estimated tokens for default variables'.
Ethan Wu: product Q: show token estimates by default? my take: show estimates for new users, hide for orgs with privacy concerns. add a per-org toggle and a per-user setting to opt out.
Harper Lin: visual contrast: the compact token pill uses a muted background. bump to solid surface on focus and add a 3px outline for keyboard focus. icons need 4.5:1.
Noah Bennett: implementation detail: interrupt should abort the inflight request but keep context. restart should clear generation state but keep the user's message and KV cache. append spawns a separate message block with new tokens. debounce regen clicks by 400ms.
Leah Ortiz: screen reader flow: on regen selection, announce only final state once done: 'Generation complete: 98 tokens' or 'Generation interrupted by user'. ensure focus returns to composer.
Zoe Park: copy experiments: also testing 'Interrupt' vs 'Pause' in usability study. preliminary gut says Interrupt communicates stopping without losing draft.
Ethan Wu: mobile fallback: chevron menu becomes long-press on regen icon. show ephemeral label 'Long-press for options' on first use.
Harper Lin: animation/accessibility: implement prefers-reduced-motion and prefer-reduced-data flags. if reduced-data is on, hide live token meter and use static 'estimating...' state.
Noah Bennett: logging: emit events for 'regen_choice' with values restart|append, and 'interrupt' with reason=user|system. also track token_estimate_shown boolean.
DesignBot: figma saved by Zoe Park at 1769604460  https://www.figma.com/file/unique/playground-split-control (internal).
Zoe Park: thanks all  I'll push two Figma variants (A/B copy + append flow) and record a quick keyboard walkthrough. ping me if you want to join the usability session next week. :sparkles:
